# Plott MCP

Public listing for the [Plott](https://plott.uk/mcp) remote MCP server.

Connect MCP clients to `https://plott.uk/api/mcp` (Streamable HTTP + OAuth).

This repository is the GitHub-backed listing for the [MCP Registry](https://github.com/mcp). Product source stays in the private Plott app.
